dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I have a book for your mom. Can I visit your family this weekend?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪ ˈhæv ə ˈbʊk fər jʊr ˈmɑːm. kən aɪ ˈvɪzɪt jʊr ˈfæməli ðɪs ˈwiːkɛnd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sorry, Emma. My parents have gone away for a week.
dialogue.reading: ˈsɑːri, ˈɛmə. maɪ ˈpɛrənts hæv ˈɡɔːn əˈweɪ fər ə ˈwiːk.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: To Vietnam. They have some time off from school.
dialogue.reading: tə ˌviːɛtˈnɑːm. ðeɪ ˈhæv sʌm ˈtaɪm ˈɔːf frəm ˈskuːl.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nice! Have they been to Vietnam before?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs! hæv ðeɪ bɪn tə ˌviːɛtˈnɑːm bɪˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes, they have. They went there on their honeymoon!
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs, ðeɪ ˈhæv. ðeɪ ˈwɛnt ˈðɛr ɑːn ðɛr ˈhʌnimuːn!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: How lovely! Did they plan this trip?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ ˈlʌvli! dɪd ðeɪ ˈplæn ðɪs ˈtrɪp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, a travel agent planned everything. Is your dad in Canada now?
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ə ˈtrævəl ˌeɪdʒənt ˈplænd ˈɛvriθɪŋ. ɪz jʊr ˈdæd ɪn ˈkænədə ˈnaʊ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: No, he's gone to Japan on a business trip. He's been there ten times!
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, hiːz ˈɡɔːn tə dʒəˈpæn ɑːn ə ˈbɪznəs ˌtrɪp. hiːz bɪn ˈðɛr ˈtɛn ˈtaɪmz!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Wow! I've been to Japan only once.
dialogue.reading: ˈwaʊ! aɪv bɪn tə dʒəˈpæn ˈoʊnli ˈwʌns.
